title: SWSE Force V2 Bookwise Definition Contract v2.9.0 (Legacy Era)
description: v2.6 adds Clone Wars domain semantics without weakening previous v2.5 constraints. Revision v2.8 adds separately identified Form Power definitions and strict form-talent rider contracts. Book rule says possessing talent; project override additionally requires active form state, kept in its own policy field. Legacy Era adds explicit dual-action activation, per-target area half damage and persistent spell costs; forbid text-only mechanic inference.

lightsaberFormRules.description: A Form Power requires its printed activated lightsaber equipment prerequisite. Its named rider is granted by knowing the associated form talent; no separate active-form stance is required unless an individual printed rider expressly states otherwise.
